summary_en: SMC authorized acquisition of up to 1 million shares (1.6% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases from November 25, 2026 to March 24, 2027, targeting shareholder returns, capital efficiency improvement, and securing substitute shares.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, SMC Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1 million shares of common stock for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 25, 2026 through March 24, 2027.

The 1 million shares represent 1.6% of outstanding shares (calculated against 62,429,333 shares excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026). The company stated three objectives for the buyback: enhancing shareholder returns, improving capital efficiency, and securing substitute shares for use in share-based compensation programs.

The company noted that acquisition may not occur in full or in part depending on market conditions.
